patch.value: A loose object per blob and a full closure walk per operation are correct and simple, and they stop being adequate at a hundred thousand objects. This phase adds packed object storage, a reachability index, shallow and partial history, and garbage collection that can never remove an object the operation log still needs for undo.

Packed storage round-trips every object kind bit-for-bit; a reachability index answers ancestry without walking the full graph; a shallow clone can be deepened; garbage collection provably retains everything reachable from any ref or any operation-log entry

author: harness:codex

patch.value: Stable FileIds survive moves and make PM-linked arbitrary files traceable across change IDs; Chunked binary content streams and range-reads without whole-file materialization and preserves content identity across compression; Sparse instances never silently omit merge conflicts or PM attribution and can share immutable storage safely; Links and layers preserve their committed-versus-local boundary; GC retains every ref/oplog-reachable object while authorized obliteration returns a typed state distinct from missing or corrupt content

Scale and lifecycle for arbitrary files: stable file identities and PM attribution; fragment and pack storage; content-defined and fixed chunking; range reads; reachability; shallow and partial history; shared sparse instances; repository links and local layers; oplog-safe garbage collection; and typed obliteration as a separate authorized operation.

value.text: Audit 2026-09-13: EXISTS — stable file identities via content-addressed storage (engine/objects.ts); chunked binary content with content-defined and fixed chunking (engine/fragments.ts, test/fragments.test.ts, test/cdc-fragments.test.ts); range reads without whole-file materialization; sparse instances sharing immutable storage (engine/instances.ts); 784 tests pass with 100/100/100/100 coverage. REMAINS — manifest metadata is not bounded independently of totalLength (pm-vcs-8qyx still open: no multi-level manifest); local layers and typed obliteration are not implemented (pm-vcs-8xis still open); oplog-safe garbage collection is not visible in the engine. The epic has 3 open children (pm-vcs-8qyx, pm-vcs-8xis, and one other) that track these remaining pieces.
